**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 already sits at or above our preferred warranty position:

- **19.1** — professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications.
- **19.2** — 90 days for each Deliverable, measured from the *later* of delivery or acceptance (a customer-favourable start date), and hosted Services conform **throughout the subscription term**, which exceeds our 12-month software benchmark.
- **19.3** — no malicious code intentionally introduced, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminution, and open-source protection for Customer source code.
- **19.4** — prompt re-performance / repair / replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **19.5** — the disclaimer reaches implied warranties only and expressly confirms that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not erode the express warranties.
